policy.status: implemented restrained progression and shared permanent caps
policy.permanent_bonus_order: Apply level growth once, add like bonuses across every permanent source, apply shared caps once, resolve armor-derived physical resistance once. Show applied and excess bonuses in previews.
policy.ordinary_output_target: Permanent builds stay within approximately +25% ordinary expected DPS and +25% effective HP in either damage channel, relative to the same bare unit and level; rounding tolerance is reviewed explicitly.
policy.conditional_effect_budget: Small average benefit or a narrow strong matchup; pay through cost, recovery, reduced baseline stats, limited charges, or a weakness. No additional independent multiplier ladder.
policy.return_policy: One return allowance per paid unit instance; Gravebound Knight returns at 25% HP and reduced speed. Gear returns cannot turn it into several full lives.
policy.enemy_growth: Same shallow HP and damage curves; defenses and critical profiles fixed by type. Normal campaign levels still rise 1 to 20. Never stack the old stage multipliers unchanged.
policy.viability_gate: Playtest Peasant, Militia, Spearman, Swordsman, and Archer at comparable investment in zones 8 to 10. Every card needs repeated useful encounters; economic fodder alone is insufficient for all early infantry.
policy.reserve_entry_rule: Retune reserve base stats and costs to these budgets before admitting them; old reserve numbers are not approved power tiers.
policy.all_caps_audit_note: Extreme all-caps preview, not an assumed affordable build. Integer health rounding is included; tuning acceptance uses a 1 percentage point rounding tolerance.
